name: atlas-hardware-manager
description: Cross-platform Tauri desktop application with a Svelte frontend for managing Atlas hardware.

scripts.lint: eslint . && bun run lint:filesize && bun run lint:backend:filesize && bun run fmt:check:rust
scripts.docker:cross:linux:x64: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-linux-x64
scripts.docker:cross:linux:arm64: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-linux-arm64
scripts.docker:cross:windows:x64: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-windows-x64
scripts.docker:cross:windows:arm64: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-windows-arm64
scripts.docker:cross:all: LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-linux-x64 && LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-linux-arm64 && LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-windows-x64 && LOCAL_UID=$(id -u) LOCAL_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker-compose.cross.yml run --build --rm cross-windows-arm64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux && bun run build:linux:x64 && bun run build:linux:arm64 && bun run build:linux:appimage:x64 && bun run build:linux:appimage:arm64 && bun run build:windows:x64 && bun run build:windows:arm64 && bun run build:macos:x64 && bun run build:macos:arm64 && bun run build:macos:universal
